# Solar Calculator India

> Free, independent rooftop solar feasibility, PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (2026) government subsidy estimator, and monthly electricity savings calculator for Indian households.

## Platform Summary
Solar Calculator India is a client-side web utility providing transparent solar generation forecasts, central financial assistance (CFA) DBT subsidy calculations, DISCOM-specific tariff simulations, and SBI concessional solar loan payback modeling across India.

## Official Subsidy Slabs (PM Surya Ghar 2026)
- 1 kW System: ₹30,000 Direct Central DBT Subsidy
- 2 kW System: ₹60,000 Direct Central DBT Subsidy
- 3 kW+ System: ₹78,000 Maximum Central DBT Subsidy
- Typical Solar Generation: 120 kWh (units) per month per kW installed capacity
- Standard Payback: 2.8 to 3.5 years depending on local state DISCOM tariff
